resume_at.description: When it is resumed (reset + margin); null when it will not be.

resumed_at.description: When Roamgate sent the resume for this reset (state `resumed`).

LimitPause.description: A session paused by a usage limit, as the browsers are told.

LimitPauseState.description: What becomes of a paused session: `scheduled`, resumed at resume_at; `off`, the setting is off; `skipped`, the user chose "Don't resume" for it; `missed`, its reset passed before Roamgate saw it paused (only "Resume now"); `resuming`, being sent; `resumed`, sent for this reset already and stopped on it again (never sent twice for one reset); `failed`, the message could not be sent (`reason`): tried again at resume_at, or not any more when that is null.

enabled.description: Sessions a usage limit stopped are sent `message` once it resets.

message.description: What a resumed session is sent, as if the user typed it.

margin_seconds.description: Seconds after the reset before it is sent.

stopped_at.description: When the session stopped (the record's time, epoch ms), if said.

uuid.description: The stop record's uuid, if it has one.

message.description: What Claude Code showed ("You've hit your 5-hour limit ...").

UsageLimitStop.description: A usage limit a session stopped on, from Claude Code's own fields.
